About the filmmaker

Mugerwa Othman, aka dir.babboros

dir.babboros is the professional alias and social media handle of Mugerwa Othman, a Ugandan film director, video editor, colorist and director of photography based in Kampala.

He is the founder of Iconeon Studios, a creative pre- and post-production company in Africa that handles scripting, filming and video editing. Beyond directing, he works as a motion graphic designer, colorist, editor and online lecturer.

🎬 Director🎨 Colorist📷 DOP✂️ Editor✨ Motion Design🎓 Lecturer

The company

Iconeon Studios

The pre & post production house every creative needs. Vision Evolved. Got vision? We got the house: scripting, filming, editing, color grading and motion graphics, done right from idea to final cut.

🎯

Purpose

Iconeon Studios exists to create, produce and distribute cinematic work that inspires, educates and entertains.

🔭

Vision

To be a leading pre and post production house, recognized for innovation and cinematic excellence.

🎬

Mission

To produce and deliver high quality films, documentaries and branded content through collaboration, creativity and professionalism.

Our story

2022

The vision of starting a film company begins. Its first name is Icon Graphix Filmz Channel, with the slogan “King of Moment”.

24 November 2025

The name changes to Iconeon Studios, with a new slogan: “Vision Evolved”.

Today

A film and video production company handling pre and post production for music videos, films, documentaries and branded content.
